title: Therapy Extension Visits beyond the Units Requested
content:
## Extension visits — Medicaid Managed Care Membership

**Clause.** Course visits beyond the units the authorization originally requested are extension visits. The number of extension visits is the number of course visits less the units requested on the member's rehabilitation therapy authorization, and never below zero. Their re-rated copay follows how the authorization was extended and whether care management took part:

- Where the authorization approved more units than were requested and the member enrolled in a care management episode during the therapy window, extension visits re-rate at the coordinated extension copay of 0.00 USD.
- Where more units were approved than requested and no such enrollment exists, extension visits re-rate at the uncoordinated extension copay of 1.00 USD.
- Otherwise extension visits re-rate like every other course visit of the course.

The units requested and the units approved are those on the member's rehabilitation therapy authorization in the Prior Authorization records; the enrollment is an episode in the member's Care Management records whose enrollment date falls in the therapy window, the 12 months counted back from the review date.

## Condition grid

| Units approved compared with units requested | Care management episode enrolled in the therapy window | Extension visit copay |
|---|---|---|
| More approved than requested | Yes | 0.00 USD |
| More approved than requested | No | 1.00 USD |
| Approved equal to or fewer than requested | Either | Same re-rated copay as the course's other visits |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An authorization requested 8 units and approved 12; the course holds 11 visits, and the member enrolled in a care management episode during the therapy window. Extension visits: 11 less 8, which is 3; each re-rates at 0.00 USD.
- The same authorization and course with no episode enrolled in the window: the 3 extension visits re-rate at 1.00 USD each, 3.00 USD in all.
- A course of 6 visits under an authorization that requested 8 units holds no extension visit.
